mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.0% in a month, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate signals an aggressive monetary policy response to a weakening labor market, which typically precedes a period of equity market underperformance over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing in response to labor weakness
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises by at least 0.2 percentage points in the same month, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by slowing GDP growth, a decline in the quarterly real GDP growth rate below 2.0% signals an impending economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansion when GDPC1 growth falls below 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production growth over the past two months signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth declines by at least 0.5% over the prior two months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized housing starts rate falls below 1,500,000 units, it signals a contraction in the residential construction sector that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 1500, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based contraction in consumer spending and housing activity, which typically precedes a period of equity market underperformance over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 0.5% over the prior two months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-employment regime characterized by unemployment rates below 5.0%, a decline in payroll employment growth signals an imminent labor market slowdown that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0% and PAYEMS growth declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
